options.content:
There is no single productivity number

Productivity is output divided by effort, and teams disagree about both terms. Rather than choose one definition, this reports the same data under five and shows the spread. Read the row matching how your team counts.

Every figure here is a difference, not a gain. AI-assisted and unassisted commits are self-selected, not randomised — nothing on this page supports a causal claim. Commits with no evidence collected are excluded rather than counted as unassisted. Check the rework rate before reading any output figure.

panels.title: Output per unit of effort — five definitions
panels.description: There is no single productivity ratio. Each row divides output by a different measure of effort; read the row matching how your team defines it. The spread between rows is the point — one number would hide it. Difference, not gain: the two cohorts are self-selected, not randomised. Blank instead of a percentage when either side has under 5 commits. Compares two measured cohorts only: commits with no evidence collected (undetermined, uninstrumented, unmatched, degraded) are excluded, not counted as unassisted — that would report absence as a measured negative.

targets.rawSql:
-- Five definitions of Output/Effort, each computed both sides of the
-- assisted split. No definition is privileged: a team that counts issues
-- disagrees with one that counts lines, and both are shown rather than
-- one being chosen for them.
--
-- Every denominator here is a measure of EFFORT. "Per person" is
-- deliberately absent: assisted contributors were active on far more days,
-- so a per-person ratio reports more time spent as though it were more
-- output per unit of time. It read +137% where per-person-day read +3%.
WITH c AS (
  SELECT c.*, COALESCE(t.name,'(unassigned)') team
  FROM whodunit_commits c LEFT JOIN whodunit_identities wi ON wi.alias = c.contributor
    LEFT JOIN team_users tu ON tu.user_id = COALESCE(wi.canonical, c.contributor)
    LEFT JOIN teams t ON t.id = tu.team_id
  WHERE c.committed_at BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom()*1000000000 AND $__unixEpochTo()*1000000000
    AND c.contributor IS NOT NULL AND c.status IN ('assisted','unassisted','undetermined','uninstrumented','unmatched','degraded')
    -- All six statuses are named so this set stays complete as dun's list
    -- grows. Only two are compared: the other four mean no evidence was
    -- collected, and counting them as unassisted would report absence as a
    -- measured negative (NAV-21). CASE maps them to NULL, which drops them.
    AND CASE c.status WHEN 'assisted' THEN 1 WHEN 'unassisted' THEN 1 END = 1 AND ('${contributor:raw}' = '__all__' OR c.contributor = '${contributor:raw}')
    AND ('${team:raw}' = '__all__' OR COALESCE(t.name,'(unassigned)') = '${team:raw}')
),
agg AS (
  SELECT status, COUNT(*) commits,
         SUM(lines_added+lines_removed) total_lines,
         SUM(files_changed) files,
         COUNT(DISTINCT CONCAT(contributor,'|',DATE(FROM_UNIXTIME(committed_at/1000000000)))) person_days
  FROM c GROUP BY status
),
n AS (SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN status='assisted' THEN commits END) na,
             MAX(CASE WHEN status='unassisted' THEN commits END) nu FROM agg)
SELECT d.definition, d.a AS `AI-assisted`, d.u AS `Unassisted`,
       CASE WHEN d.u > 0 AND n.na >= 5 AND n.nu >= 5
            THEN ROUND(100*(d.a-d.u)/d.u,0) END AS `Difference %`,
       CONCAT(n.na,' / ',n.nu) AS `n assisted / n not`
FROM (
  SELECT 'Commits per person-day' definition, 1 ord,
    ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN status='assisted'   THEN commits/NULLIF(person_days,0) END),2) a,
    ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN status='unassisted' THEN commits/NULLIF(person_days,0) END),2) u FROM agg
  UNION ALL SELECT 'Lines per person-day', 2,
    ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN status='assisted'   THEN total_lines/NULLIF(person_days,0) END),0),
    ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN status='unassisted' THEN total_lines/NULLIF(person_days,0) END),0) FROM agg
  UNION ALL SELECT 'Lines per commit', 3,
    ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN status='assisted'   THEN total_lines/NULLIF(commits,0) END),0),
    ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN status='unassisted' THEN total_lines/NULLIF(commits,0) END),0) FROM agg
  UNION ALL SELECT 'Files per commit', 4,
    ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN status='assisted'   THEN files/NULLIF(commits,0) END),1),
    ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN status='unassisted' THEN files/NULLIF(commits,0) END),1) FROM agg
  UNION ALL SELECT 'Files per person-day', 5,
    ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN status='assisted'   THEN files/NULLIF(person_days,0) END),1),
    ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN status='unassisted' THEN files/NULLIF(person_days,0) END),1) FROM agg
) d CROSS JOIN n ORDER BY d.ord

panels.title: Rework rate — the gate on every number left
panels.description: Share of commits whose purpose is a fix. A difference in output means nothing if it arrives with more rework, so read this before any row of the table. This is a fix RATE, not a defect rate — it counts commits labelled fix, not bugs found. Compares two measured cohorts only: commits with no evidence collected (undetermined, uninstrumented, unmatched, degraded) are excluded, not counted as unassisted — that would report absence as a measured negative.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT CASE WHEN c.status='assisted' THEN 'AI-assisted' ELSE 'Unassisted' END AS metric,
       ROUND(100*SUM(c.purpose='fix')/COUNT(*),1) AS value
FROM whodunit_commits c LEFT JOIN whodunit_identities wi ON wi.alias = c.contributor
    LEFT JOIN team_users tu ON tu.user_id = COALESCE(wi.canonical, c.contributor)
    LEFT JOIN teams t ON t.id = tu.team_id
WHERE c.committed_at BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom()*1000000000 AND $__unixEpochTo()*1000000000
  AND c.contributor IS NOT NULL AND c.status IN ('assisted','unassisted','undetermined','uninstrumented','unmatched','degraded')
    -- All six statuses are named so this set stays complete as dun's list
    -- grows. Only two are compared: the other four mean no evidence was
    -- collected, and counting them as unassisted would report absence as a
    -- measured negative (NAV-21). CASE maps them to NULL, which drops them.
    AND CASE c.status WHEN 'assisted' THEN 1 WHEN 'unassisted' THEN 1 END = 1 AND ('${contributor:raw}' = '__all__' OR c.contributor = '${contributor:raw}')
    AND ('${team:raw}' = '__all__' OR COALESCE(t.name,'(unassigned)') = '${team:raw}')
GROUP BY c.status
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5

panels.title: Same comparison, split by work type
panels.description: Average change size per commit, by purpose. This is the check on the table above: if assisted work skews toward features and unassisted toward docs, an overall difference is composition, not productivity. A purpose with under 5 commits on a side is omitted. Compares two measured cohorts only: commits with no evidence collected (undetermined, uninstrumented, unmatched, degraded) are excluded, not counted as unassisted — that would report absence as a measured negative.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT c.purpose AS metric,
       CASE WHEN c.status='assisted' THEN 'AI-assisted' ELSE 'Unassisted' END AS series,
       ROUND(AVG(c.lines_added+c.lines_removed),0) AS value
FROM whodunit_commits c LEFT JOIN whodunit_identities wi ON wi.alias = c.contributor
    LEFT JOIN team_users tu ON tu.user_id = COALESCE(wi.canonical, c.contributor)
    LEFT JOIN teams t ON t.id = tu.team_id
WHERE c.committed_at BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom()*1000000000 AND $__unixEpochTo()*1000000000
  AND c.contributor IS NOT NULL AND c.status IN ('assisted','unassisted','undetermined','uninstrumented','unmatched','degraded')
    -- All six statuses are named so this set stays complete as dun's list
    -- grows. Only two are compared: the other four mean no evidence was
    -- collected, and counting them as unassisted would report absence as a
    -- measured negative (NAV-21). CASE maps them to NULL, which drops them.
    AND CASE c.status WHEN 'assisted' THEN 1 WHEN 'unassisted' THEN 1 END = 1
  AND c.purpose IN ('feature','fix','test','docs','refactor') AND ('${contributor:raw}' = '__all__' OR c.contributor = '${contributor:raw}')
    AND ('${team:raw}' = '__all__' OR COALESCE(t.name,'(unassigned)') = '${team:raw}')
GROUP BY c.purpose, c.status
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5
ORDER BY c.purpose

panels.title: Where the work sits, by change size
panels.description: Commit counts per size bucket, each side of the split. Complexity is not measured directly, so change size stands in for it — two cohorts with different size profiles are not comparable on a single ratio. Compares two measured cohorts only: commits with no evidence collected (undetermined, uninstrumented, unmatched, degraded) are excluded, not counted as unassisted — that would report absence as a measured negative.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT b.bucket AS metric, b.series, ROUND(b.n) AS value FROM (
  SELECT CASE WHEN c.lines_added+c.lines_removed < 50 THEN 'small (<50)'
              WHEN c.lines_added+c.lines_removed < 300 THEN 'medium (50-299)'
              ELSE 'large (300+)' END bucket,
         CASE WHEN c.status='assisted' THEN 'AI-assisted' ELSE 'Unassisted' END series,
         COUNT(*) n,
         MIN(CASE WHEN c.lines_added+c.lines_removed < 50 THEN 1
                  WHEN c.lines_added+c.lines_removed < 300 THEN 2 ELSE 3 END) ord
  FROM whodunit_commits c LEFT JOIN whodunit_identities wi ON wi.alias = c.contributor
    LEFT JOIN team_users tu ON tu.user_id = COALESCE(wi.canonical, c.contributor)
    LEFT JOIN teams t ON t.id = tu.team_id
  WHERE c.committed_at BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom()*1000000000 AND $__unixEpochTo()*1000000000
    AND c.contributor IS NOT NULL AND c.status IN ('assisted','unassisted','undetermined','uninstrumented','unmatched','degraded')
    -- All six statuses are named so this set stays complete as dun's list
    -- grows. Only two are compared: the other four mean no evidence was
    -- collected, and counting them as unassisted would report absence as a
    -- measured negative (NAV-21). CASE maps them to NULL, which drops them.
    AND CASE c.status WHEN 'assisted' THEN 1 WHEN 'unassisted' THEN 1 END = 1 AND ('${contributor:raw}' = '__all__' OR c.contributor = '${contributor:raw}')
    AND ('${team:raw}' = '__all__' OR COALESCE(t.name,'(unassigned)') = '${team:raw}')
  GROUP BY bucket, series
) b ORDER BY b.ord

panels.title: Conditioned on work type and complexity
Does conditioning change the answer?
panels.description: The same ratio computed two ways. The first pools all work; the second compares only like with like and reweights the strata onto a common mix. When they disagree, the pooled figure was measuring which work each cohort happened to do — not how productive it was. A conditioned figure below an unconditioned one is the ordinary case, because agents get reached for on the easier tasks.

targets.rawSql:
WITH c AS (
  SELECT c.purpose,
         CASE WHEN c.files_changed < 3 THEN '1-2 files'
              WHEN c.files_changed <= 20 THEN '3-20 files'
              ELSE '20+ files' END band,
         c.status, c.lines_added + c.lines_removed AS churn,
         c.contributor, c.committed_at
  FROM whodunit_commits c LEFT JOIN whodunit_identities wi ON wi.alias = c.contributor
    LEFT JOIN team_users tu ON tu.user_id = COALESCE(wi.canonical, c.contributor)
    LEFT JOIN teams t ON t.id = tu.team_id
  WHERE c.committed_at BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom()*1000000000 AND $__unixEpochTo()*1000000000
    AND c.contributor IS NOT NULL AND c.status IN ('assisted','unassisted','undetermined','uninstrumented','unmatched','degraded')
    -- All six named so the set stays complete as dun's list grows; only two
    -- are compared, because the other four mean no evidence was collected
    -- and counting them as unassisted reports absence as a measured
    -- negative (NAV-21).
    AND CASE c.status WHEN 'assisted' THEN 1 WHEN 'unassisted' THEN 1 END = 1 AND ('${contributor:raw}' = '__all__' OR c.contributor = '${contributor:raw}')
    AND ('${team:raw}' = '__all__' OR COALESCE(t.name,'(unassigned)') = '${team:raw}')
),
cell AS (
  SELECT purpose, band, status, COUNT(*) commits,
         COUNT(DISTINCT CONCAT(contributor,'|',DATE(FROM_UNIXTIME(committed_at/1000000000)))) person_days
  FROM c GROUP BY purpose, band, status
),
pivot AS (
  SELECT purpose, band,
    MAX(CASE WHEN status='assisted'   THEN commits/NULLIF(person_days,0) END) a,
    MAX(CASE WHEN status='unassisted' THEN commits/NULLIF(person_days,0) END) u,
    MAX(CASE WHEN status='assisted'   THEN commits END) na,
    MAX(CASE WHEN status='unassisted' THEN commits END) nu
  FROM cell GROUP BY purpose, band
),
tot AS (
  SELECT status, COUNT(*) commits,
         COUNT(DISTINCT CONCAT(contributor,'|',DATE(FROM_UNIXTIME(committed_at/1000000000)))) person_days
  FROM c GROUP BY status
)
SELECT 'Unconditioned — all work pooled' AS metric,
       ROUND(100*(MAX(CASE WHEN status='assisted' THEN commits/NULLIF(person_days,0) END)
                - MAX(CASE WHEN status='unassisted' THEN commits/NULLIF(person_days,0) END))
             / MAX(CASE WHEN status='unassisted' THEN commits/NULLIF(person_days,0) END),0) AS value
FROM tot
UNION ALL
-- Weighted by the unassisted cohort's mix, so the strata are compared on a
-- common composition rather than each cohort's own.
SELECT 'Conditioned — same work type and complexity',
       ROUND(100*(SUM(a*nu)/SUM(nu) - SUM(u*nu)/SUM(nu)) / (SUM(u*nu)/SUM(nu)),0)
FROM pivot WHERE na >= 5 AND nu >= 5 AND u > 0

panels.title: Every cell, computed separately
panels.description: Commits per person-day inside each work type and complexity band, ordered by how far each cell departs from parity. A cell appears only when both sides hold at least 5 commits — the rest are withheld rather than shown thin. Cells disagreeing in direction are the finding: they mean no single figure describes this data.

targets.rawSql:
WITH c AS (
  SELECT c.purpose,
         CASE WHEN c.files_changed < 3 THEN '1-2 files'
              WHEN c.files_changed <= 20 THEN '3-20 files'
              ELSE '20+ files' END band,
         c.status, c.lines_added + c.lines_removed AS churn,
         c.contributor, c.committed_at
  FROM whodunit_commits c LEFT JOIN whodunit_identities wi ON wi.alias = c.contributor
    LEFT JOIN team_users tu ON tu.user_id = COALESCE(wi.canonical, c.contributor)
    LEFT JOIN teams t ON t.id = tu.team_id
  WHERE c.committed_at BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom()*1000000000 AND $__unixEpochTo()*1000000000
    AND c.contributor IS NOT NULL AND c.status IN ('assisted','unassisted','undetermined','uninstrumented','unmatched','degraded')
    -- All six named so the set stays complete as dun's list grows; only two
    -- are compared, because the other four mean no evidence was collected
    -- and counting them as unassisted reports absence as a measured
    -- negative (NAV-21).
    AND CASE c.status WHEN 'assisted' THEN 1 WHEN 'unassisted' THEN 1 END = 1 AND ('${contributor:raw}' = '__all__' OR c.contributor = '${contributor:raw}')
    AND ('${team:raw}' = '__all__' OR COALESCE(t.name,'(unassigned)') = '${team:raw}')
),
cell AS (
  SELECT purpose, band, status,
         COUNT(*) commits,
         COUNT(DISTINCT CONCAT(contributor,'|',DATE(FROM_UNIXTIME(committed_at/1000000000)))) person_days
  FROM c GROUP BY purpose, band, status
),
pivot AS (
  SELECT purpose, band,
    MAX(CASE WHEN status='assisted'   THEN commits/NULLIF(person_days,0) END) a,
    MAX(CASE WHEN status='unassisted' THEN commits/NULLIF(person_days,0) END) u,
    MAX(CASE WHEN status='assisted'   THEN commits END) na,
    MAX(CASE WHEN status='unassisted' THEN commits END) nu
  FROM cell GROUP BY purpose, band
)
SELECT purpose AS `Work type`, band AS `Complexity`,
       ROUND(a,2) AS `Assisted /person-day`, ROUND(u,2) AS `Unassisted /person-day`,
       ROUND(100*(a-u)/u,0) AS `Difference %`,
       CONCAT(na,' / ',nu) AS `n assisted / n not`
FROM pivot
WHERE na >= 5 AND nu >= 5 AND u > 0
ORDER BY ABS(100*(a-u)/u) DESC

panels.title: Cycle time per stratum, where the issue data supports it
panels.description: Mean days from issue creation to resolution, split by work type and complexity. This is the grain the productivity formula is usually stated on, and it is much thinner than the commit grain — most strata have under 5 issues a side and are omitted entirely. An empty chart here means not enough issues, not no difference.

targets.rawSql:
WITH iss AS (
  SELECT i.id,
         MAX(CASE WHEN w.status='assisted' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) assisted,
         MIN(w.purpose) purpose,
         CASE WHEN SUM(w.files_changed) < 3 THEN '1-2 files'
              WHEN SUM(w.files_changed) <= 20 THEN '3-20 files'
              ELSE '20+ files' END band,
         TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR, i.created_date, i.resolution_date)/24 days
  FROM issues i
  JOIN issue_commits ic ON ic.issue_id = i.id
  JOIN whodunit_commits w ON w.commit_sha = ic.commit_sha
  LEFT JOIN whodunit_identities wi ON wi.alias = w.contributor
    LEFT JOIN team_users tu ON tu.user_id = COALESCE(wi.canonical, w.contributor)
    LEFT JOIN teams t ON t.id = tu.team_id
  WHERE i.status = 'DONE' AND i.resolution_date IS NOT NULL
    -- Bare-integer keys on some trackers match unrelated commits, so the
    -- join is guarded to the PROJECT-123 shape (check-issue-key-guard.py).
    AND i.issue_key REGEXP '^[A-Z][A-Z0-9]+-[0-9]+$'
    AND $__timeFilter(i.resolution_date)
    AND ('${contributor:raw}' = '__all__' OR w.contributor = '${contributor:raw}')
    AND ('${team:raw}' = '__all__' OR COALESCE(t.name,'(unassigned)') = '${team:raw}')
  GROUP BY i.id
)
SELECT CONCAT(purpose,' · ',band) AS metric,
       CASE WHEN assisted=1 THEN 'AI-assisted' ELSE 'Unassisted' END AS series,
       ROUND(AVG(days),2) AS value
FROM iss
GROUP BY purpose, band, assisted
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5
ORDER BY metric
